message: Magic Control Ultra v6.3: separated fake Wi-Fi beacon BSSIDs from the real control access point for stable Android connectivity during broadcast.
notes: Fake broadcast networks now use unique locally administered unicast MAC addresses and no longer reuse the real Magic Control Ultra AP BSSID. This targets Android disconnect/reconnect failures when broadcast starts. Firmware version and Notes PWA cache were bumped to v63. Calc, Notes, OLED, battery monitor, BOOT, LED, beacon timing, AP name/password, SSID content, channels, Ultra OTA architecture and other core behavior were not changed.
